inicio.detalle: You appear for the first 5 seconds

pausa20.detalle: The video freezes at 20s and you talk for 6

presente.detalle: Your circle from start to finish

dos.detalle: You appear for 3s at the start and pause at 20

necesitaMinimo: Needs a video at least {seg}s long
vacio: First choose where you appear and how long each part lasts. Then you record knowing what to say. An appearance goes over the video; a pause stops it and gives you the screen.
usarTomaPropia: + use a separate take for this moment
grabaCorridos: Record {seg}s straight for {n, plural, one {# moment} other {# moments}}
unaSolaToma: One continuous take; the moments split it in order
pasaReel: Over the {seg}s limit for a Reel. Shorten a pause or the video clip.
faltaGrabacion: {n, plural, one {# moment is} other {# moments are}} missing a recording. Without it the edit can't be generated.
noAlcanza: The moments need {necesaria}s of the main take and your video is {tiene}s. It can't be generated like this.
